entities.summary: Max Shachtman was an American Marxist theorist. He went from being an associate of Leon Trotsky to a social democrat and mentor of senior assistants to AFL–CIO President George Meany. The Marxist tendency associated with his beliefs is known as Shachtmanism. Max Shachtman was a philosophers & thinkers from Warsaw (1904-09-10, Warsaw–1972-11-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
